subject: general
question:
Match the columns.

 
 

 
 
**Group-I**

 
 
 
**Group-B**

 
 
 

 
 
I. Heart

 
 
 
A. Pumping organ

 
 
 

 
 
II. Arteries

 
 
 
B. Carries deoxygenated blood

 
 
 

 
 
III. Veins

 
 
 
C. Carries oxygenated blood

options.text: I - C; II - B; III - A
I - A; II - B; III - C
I - C; II - A; III - B
I - A; II - C; III - B

solution:
The correct answer is **I - A; II - C; III - B** .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 I.**Heart** is defined as an organ** that pumps blood received from veins into arteries throughout the body**.

II.**Arteries** are defined as the** blood vessel **that **carries blood from the heart to the body**.It carries blood with **oxygen.**

III. **Veins** are defined as the **blood vessel** that **carries blood from the body to heart** .It caries blood containing **carbon-dioxide**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Heart**

 
 
• It is the primary organ of human's circulatory system.
 
• It contains four chambers made of muscles and powered by electric impulses.
 
• The blood pumped by heart which provides your body with the oxygen and nutrients it needs to function.
 
 
 
• **Arteries**
 
 
• They are responsible for the transportation of fluid.
 
• The arteries are the blood vessels that deliver oxygen-rich blood from the heart to the tissues of the body.
 
 
 
• **Veins**
 
 
• They are the parts of our circulatory system.
 
• They work together with other blood vessels and your heart to keep your blood moving.
 
• Veins hold most of the blood in your body.
